name: Dan Winter
tagline: I design applied learning for customer and partner teams — and I still build the courses.
headline: Learning experience design leader
summary: I design learning for customer and partner teams, and I still build the courses. Fifteen years in customer education. At Okta I lead learning experience and digital design: the standards, how AI-assisted work gets reviewed, and the courses themselves.
bioParagraphs: I design applied, scenario-based learning so customer and partner teams can use what they learn in the flow of work.
Promoted twice in under three years at Okta to lead learning experience and digital design. Recipient of the CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation.
I set content standards, govern AI-assisted authoring, and stay hands-on — building courses, simulations, and the systems that help teams ship quality at scale.
